facts.text: Under the Nebraska Promise, eligible Nebraska residents with household income of $65,000 or less receive full tuition coverage for up to 30 credit hours per academic year.

sources.title: Nebraska Promise | Admissions | University of Nebraska at Omaha
sources.quote: If you are eligible for a Federal Pell Grant or have Family income of $65,000 or less (Adjusted Gross Income or AGI), Nebraska Promise will cover all your remaining tuition costs, up to 30 credit hours per academic year
